description: MLflow CLI: garbage collection and deletion of runs, experiments, and models, database migrations, and read commands. `mlflow run` runs the code of an MLflow project.

rules.note: `gc` deletes runs and their artifacts for good. `experiments delete`, `runs delete`, and model deletions remove tracking data.
`db upgrade` migrates the tracking database schema. An older server cannot read it after the change.

project_commands.note: `mlflow run` runs the entry point of an MLflow project, local or from a Git URL. `models serve` and `models predict` load and run a model.

safe.note: Searches and listings of experiments, runs, and artifacts, run details, and artifact downloads to this computer.
